decisions.reason: The ERP interface fits the firm's multichannel strategy and is still a valuable integration option at low upkeep, though not seeing it on the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
As the lead price comparison tracker it is cheap to keep listed and keeps an analytics option open, but four years on its value should be clearer and the lack of visibility suggests modest results.

After four years, a redundant tracker variant with no visible traction holds little option value, and folding it into C frees maintenance capacity, especially as shop platform updates raise upkeep costs.
Like D, this overlapping tracker variant has had enough time to show its value, and consolidating it avoids repeated porting costs with little loss of opportunity.
Its companion product A has been withdrawn, which weakens F, but net price reporting still serves B2B shop clients at low cost, so the option is kept a little longer under close review.
